pages.text: Brutes are living siege engines with short tempers and attacks heavy enough to leave a fighter Dazed.$(br2)Watch the body, not merely the weapon. Space is safety when a Brute commits to a slam. Its heart is a valuable charm for anyone who survives collecting it.
Large, loud, and surprisingly quick once anger wins the argument.

pages.title: Armored Hide
pages.text: Now and then a blow glances off a Brute's armor and does no damage at all, with a spark and a ring of steel. It cannot happen twice in a few seconds, so keep swinging.
